headline: Six Years After a Reckoning, Criterion Puts ‘Cinematic Blackness’ in Focus
context: Adding a curator, the Criterion Collection expanded its offerings and its vision of Black film. But auteurs continue to push the company on what inclusion means.

sources.name: The New York Times
